document: The reviewed notes of the marathon race directory for this release (docs/RACES.md): the evidence files the family binds, race flags the registry’s rule does not give (`flags`) or gives wrongly (`clears`), each with its evidence, the lead’s rulings that allow a flagged race a page (`page_rulings`), the search aliases (`aliases`: a word as the release writes it and its common English name) and the rulings on the pairs of the duplicate-edition audit (`duplicate_editions`). analysis/build_races.py reads it and scripts/verify-races.cjs checks it; the race registry is frozen and holds none of this.

editions: 45th GMAA Green Mtn. Marathon & Half Marathon
duplicate_editions.note: Listed by the near rule: every name of the smaller list is in the other and nearly all finish within one two-minute window of each other. The producer’s notes give both the same race day. Suggested to the lead on 2026-11-14: set the Green Mtn edition aside.

Listed by the time-only rule: the two lists share several times more finish seconds than chance gives, almost all between 5:00 and 6:30, under different names. Not one list twice. Suggested to the lead on 2026-11-14: keep both and tell the producer.

Listed by the near rule: the same names in both years, every finish shifted by the same amount. The data do not say which year is the real one. Suggested to the lead on 2026-11-14: set one aside after asking the producer.
